senses.en: Thin strands growing on the skin of people and animals.
A single strand growing from skin.

ex.en: She tied her hair back before making lunch.
ex.zh: 她做午饭前把头发扎了起来。

ex.en: Some workplaces are relaxing rules about hair and clothing to create a more inclusive environment.
ex.zh: 一些工作场所正在放宽对发型和服装的规定，以营造更包容的环境。

col: a strand of hair｜一缕头发
tip: 整体头发不可数；一根头发用a hair。

senses.en: Having the colour of grass and most leaves.
Causing little harm to the environment.
The colour of grass and most leaves.

ex.en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件绿色夹克来搭配鞋子。

ex.en: Governments can encourage green transport by improving public services and building safer routes for cyclists.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过改善公共服务和修建更安全的自行车道来鼓励绿色出行。

col: go green｜采取环保生活方式
tip: 除颜色外，green常表示环保；形容人还可指缺乏经验。

senses.en: A small round fruit growing in bunches on vines.

ex.en: She packed some grapes in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里装了一些葡萄。

ex.en: Farmers growing grapes may need more efficient irrigation systems as summers become hotter and drier.
ex.zh: 随着夏季变得更炎热、更干燥，葡萄种植者可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。

col: a bunch of grapes｜一串葡萄
tip: 单颗葡萄用a grape，一串用a bunch of grapes。

senses.en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention.
To give someone or something a particular name.
A telephone conversation or a public request for action.

ex.en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。

ex.en: Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 环保团体呼吁制定更严格的法规，减少流入河流和海洋的塑料垃圾。

col: call for action｜呼吁采取行动
call someone back｜给某人回电话
tip: call sb表示给某人打电话，不加to。

senses.en: A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.

ex.en: I added some cheese to my warm vegetable sandwich.
ex.zh: 我在热乎乎的蔬菜三明治里加了些奶酪。

ex.en: Although cheese provides protein and calcium, some varieties contain high levels of salt and saturated fat.
ex.zh: 虽然奶酪能提供蛋白质和钙，但有些品种的盐和饱和脂肪含量较高。

col: a slice of cheese｜一片奶酪
tip: 通常不可数；一块奶酪用a piece of cheese。

senses.en: Extending a great distance or lasting a great time.
For a great amount of time.
To want something very strongly, especially something unavailable.

ex.en: Her long scarf nearly touched the wet pavement.
ex.zh: 她的长围巾差点碰到湿漉漉的人行道。

ex.en: Long commuting times can reduce workers' leisure opportunities and negatively affect their overall quality of life.
ex.zh: 长时间通勤会减少劳动者的休闲机会，并对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。

col: long to do something｜渴望做某事
tip: 动词long后接for加名词，或to加动词原形。

senses.en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight.
A section extending from the main part of a building.
A group within an organisation sharing particular views or aims.

ex.en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
ex.zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。

ex.en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
ex.zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。

col: spread your wings｜展开翅膀；拓展自我
tip: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。

senses.en: an occasion when people gather to discuss something
an occasion when people come together, by arrangement or chance

ex.en: Our team meeting starts right after lunch today.
ex.zh: 我们团队今天午饭后马上开会。

ex.en: Regular meetings between teachers and parents can help identify learning difficulties at an early stage.
ex.zh: 教师与家长定期会面有助于及早发现学习困难。

tip: 参加会议用attend a meeting；meeting也可指会面。

senses.en: in a good way; also used to start a sentence

ex.en: She sings very well.
ex.zh: 她唱歌唱得很好。

ex.en: Well, let's start the lesson.
ex.zh: 好了，我们开始上课吧。

tip: well 作副词“很好地”；作感叹词引出话题。
scene: A teacher clapping and saying well done to a student.

senses.en: A person, traditionally male, who serves food in a restaurant

ex.en: The waiter brought our soup and two warm rolls.
ex.zh: 服务员端来了我们的汤和两个热乎乎的小面包。

ex.en: A well-trained waiter can improve the dining experience by responding patiently to customers with different needs.
ex.zh: 训练有素的服务员可以耐心回应不同顾客的需求，提升用餐体验。

col: work as a waiter｜当餐厅服务员
tip: waiter传统上指男服务员；server更不强调性别。

senses.en: filled with fog, making things difficult to see
unclear or difficult to remember or understand

ex.en: The road was so foggy that we drove slowly.
ex.zh: 路上雾很大，我们只好慢慢开车。

ex.en: Foggy conditions can disrupt air travel, causing delays that affect both passengers and airport operations.
ex.zh: 大雾天气可能扰乱航空出行，造成延误，影响乘客和机场运营。

col: a foggy morning｜雾蒙蒙的早晨
tip: foggy既可形容天气，也可形容记忆模糊。

senses.en: twice the usual amount, size, or quantity
become twice as much, or make something twice as much
an amount that is twice as large as another

ex.en: I ordered a double portion of rice for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午饭点了双份米饭。

ex.en: The city plans to double its investment in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 该市计划将自行车基础设施投资增加一倍，以缓解交通拥堵。

col: double in size｜规模扩大一倍
tip: double表示变为原来的两倍，即增加一倍。

senses.en: an organisation that holds money and provides financial services
land along the edge of a river or lake
put money into an account at a bank

ex.en: I went to the bank to open an account.
ex.zh: 我去银行开了一个账户。

ex.en: Banks can support local economic development by offering affordable loans to small businesses and new entrepreneurs.
ex.zh: 银行可以向小企业和初创创业者提供低成本贷款，以支持当地经济发展。

tip: 岸边用on the bank；银行里用at或in the bank。

senses.en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.

ex.en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
ex.zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。

ex.en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。

col: a wildlife reserve｜野生生物保护区
tip: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

senses.en: A thick woven covering for a floor.

ex.en: We sat on the carpet and played cards.
ex.zh: 我们坐在地毯上打牌。

ex.en: Installing carpet in classrooms can reduce noise, although regular cleaning is necessary to maintain good hygiene.
ex.zh: 在教室里铺地毯可以降低噪声，但需要定期清洁以保持良好卫生。

tip: carpet常指大面积地毯；rug多指可移动的小块地毯。

senses.en: a room where students are taught

ex.en: Sunlight filled the classroom as we opened our books.
ex.zh: 我们打开书本时，阳光洒满了教室。

ex.en: A well-designed classroom should provide adequate lighting, comfortable furniture, and enough space for students to work together.
ex.zh: 设计良好的教室应有充足的照明、舒适的家具，以及供学生合作学习的足够空间。

tip: in the classroom强调教室内；in class强调上课中。

senses.en: From one side or end to the other, within something.
By using a particular method, person, or process.
From beginning to end, or from one side to another.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
ex.zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。

ex.en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。

tip: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

senses.en: An arrangement or idea for what to do in future.
To decide what to do and how to do it.
A drawing showing the layout of a building or area.

ex.en: Our plan is to leave early and avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们的计划是早点出发，避开拥堵。

ex.en: Cities need a clear plan for expanding public transport before introducing restrictions on private vehicles.
ex.zh: 城市在实施私家车限制措施之前，需要制定明确的公共交通扩展计划。

col: plan to do something｜计划做某事
tip: plan to do表示打算做；过去式planned双写n。

senses.en: the tools and other items needed for a particular activity

ex.en: Please put the camping equipment back in the garage.
ex.zh: 请把露营装备放回车库。

ex.en: Schools need suitable laboratory equipment to give students practical experience and encourage an interest in science.
ex.zh: 学校需要合适的实验室设备，让学生获得实践经验并培养科学兴趣。

col: a piece of equipment｜一件设备
tip: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。

senses.en: problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience
to cause someone worry or ask them for help

ex.en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。

ex.en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
ex.zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。

col: have trouble doing something｜做某事有困难
take the trouble to do something｜费心做某事
tip: 表示做某事有困难，用have trouble doing。

senses.en: said when you say goodbye at night or go to bed

ex.en: Good night, sleep well.
ex.zh: 晚安，睡个好觉。

ex.en: Mum kissed me and said good night.
ex.zh: 妈妈亲了我一下，说了晚安。

tip: good night 用于道别或睡前；即使天黑见面也用 good evening。
scene: A mother tucking her child into bed and switching off the light.

senses.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

ex.en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
ex.zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。

ex.en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
ex.zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。

tip: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

senses.en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm.
Unlikely to fail or lead to loss.
A strong locked container for money and valuable objects.

ex.en: Your bike is safe inside our locked garage.
ex.zh: 你的自行车放在我们锁好的车库里很安全。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all communities have access to safe drinking water and reliable sanitation.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有社区都能获得安全饮用水和可靠的卫生设施。

col: keep someone safe｜保护某人安全
tip: safe是形容词，safety是名词；注意词性区别。

senses.en: having a pleasant flavour

ex.en: This tasty soup is perfect for a cold evening.
ex.zh: 这道美味的汤很适合寒冷的夜晚。

ex.en: School canteens can encourage healthier eating by offering tasty meals made with fresh vegetables and whole grains.
ex.zh: 学校食堂可以提供用新鲜蔬菜和全谷物制作的美味餐食，鼓励更健康的饮食。

tip: tasty指食物美味；tasteful指有品位。

senses.en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting

ex.en: A translucent jellyfish drifted past our boat this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，一只半透明的水母从我们船边漂过。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures may encourage jellyfish populations to grow, potentially disrupting marine ecosystems and coastal tourism.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升可能促使水母数量增加，进而扰乱海洋生态系统并影响沿海旅游业。

col: a swarm of jellyfish｜一大群水母
tip: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。

senses.en: making you laugh or smile
unusual or difficult to explain

ex.en: That funny story made everyone at the table laugh.
ex.zh: 那个好笑的故事逗得桌边的人都笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use funny examples to make difficult concepts more memorable and encourage students to participate.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用有趣的例子，让复杂概念更容易记住，并鼓励学生参与。

col: find something funny｜觉得某事好笑
tip: funny侧重好笑或奇怪；fun侧重令人愉快、有趣。

senses.en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust
a type of fiction intended to frighten its audience

ex.en: She watched in horror as her laptop fell downstairs.
ex.zh: 她惊恐地看着自己的笔记本电脑掉下楼梯。

ex.en: Horror films often use music and lighting to create tension rather than relying entirely on frightening images.
ex.zh: 恐怖电影常用音乐和灯光制造紧张气氛，而非完全依赖吓人的画面。

tip: 情绪义通常不可数；in horror表示惊恐地。

senses.en: A small official sticker showing that postage has been paid.
A tool that presses a mark, or the mark it leaves.
Press a mark onto something, or bring a foot down hard.

ex.en: She put a stamp on the envelope before leaving.
ex.zh: 她出门前在信封上贴了一张邮票。

ex.en: Although digital communication has reduced letter writing, collecting stamps remains a way to explore history and culture.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信减少了书信往来，集邮仍是一种探索历史与文化的方式。

col: stamp a passport｜在护照上盖章
tip: 邮票用a stamp；“在信封上贴邮票”用put a stamp on。

senses.en: used to say that something is disappointing or unlucky

ex.en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 遗憾的是，面包店的新鲜面包已经卖完了。

ex.en: Unfortunately, many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with reliable internet access.
ex.zh: 遗憾的是，许多乡村学校缺乏为学生提供可靠网络连接所需的资源。

col: unfortunately for someone｜对某人来说不幸的是
unfortunately not｜遗憾的是并非如此
tip: 常置于句首并加逗号，对整件事表示遗憾。

senses.en: happening or done most often in a particular situation

ex.en: Our usual table by the window was already taken.
ex.zh: 我们平时坐的窗边那张桌子已经有人了。

ex.en: Working from home has become the usual arrangement for some employees in the technology sector.
ex.zh: 对科技行业的一些员工来说，居家办公已成为常规安排。

col: the usual routine｜惯常的生活规律
tip: as usual意为“照常”；than usual意为“比平时”。

senses.en: To give money for something or for someone's work
Money received regularly for doing a job
To bring a benefit or be worth doing

ex.en: Can I pay for these apples by card?
ex.zh: 这些苹果可以刷卡付款吗？

ex.en: Employers should pay workers fairly to improve staff morale and reduce the number of people leaving.
ex.zh: 雇主应公平支付员工薪酬，以提高士气并减少人员流失。

tip: pay for接所购物品；pay接账单或款额；过去式paid。

senses.en: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles
an open public area surrounded by buildings
shaped like a square, or expressing area in squared units

ex.en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。

ex.en: Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。

tip: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

senses.en: Having lived or existed for a long time.
Having a particular age.
Belonging to an earlier period of someone's life.

ex.en: Our old dog sleeps beside the warm kitchen stove.
ex.zh: 我们家的老狗睡在温暖的厨房炉子旁。

ex.en: Preserving old buildings can protect cultural heritage while attracting visitors and supporting the local economy.
ex.zh: 保护古老建筑既能保护文化遗产，也能吸引游客并支持当地经济。

tip: an old friend通常指相识已久，不一定年纪大。

senses.en: The lowest part of something.
The part of your body that you sit on.
In the lowest position.

ex.en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙在包的最底下。

ex.en: Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.
ex.zh: 废弃物经常堆积在河底，破坏栖息地并威胁水生生物。

col: from top to bottom｜从上到下
tip: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。

senses.en: to put on clothes to see if they fit

ex.en: Can I try on this jacket, please?
ex.zh: 请问我可以试穿这件夹克吗？

ex.en: She tried on three dresses before choosing one.
ex.zh: 她试了三件裙子才选了一件。

tip: try on 是“试穿”；try it on 中代词放中间。
scene: A girl trying on a jacket in front of a shop mirror.

senses.en: Something incorrect that you do, say, or believe.
To wrongly identify someone or understand something incorrectly.

ex.en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。

ex.en: Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.
ex.zh: 教师应鼓励学生从错误中学习，而不是因为犯错而感到羞愧。

col: learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习
mistake A for B｜把A误认成B
tip: 说make a mistake，不说do；动词过去式为mistook。

senses.en: A place where something is built, happens, or once existed.
A collection of connected web pages.
Place or build something in a particular location.

ex.en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
ex.zh: 工人们在建筑工地周围围起了围栏。

ex.en: The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 拟建医院的选址靠近公共交通，方便居民获得医疗服务。

tip: site指地点或网站；sight指视力或景象，二者同音。

senses.en: To say or do something again.
Something that happens or is shown again.

ex.en: Could you repeat the address a little more slowly?
ex.zh: 你能把地址再慢一点说一遍吗？

ex.en: Students who repeat new vocabulary aloud regularly may develop greater confidence when speaking a foreign language.
ex.zh: 经常大声重复新词汇的学生，在说外语时可能会更有信心。

col: repeat after someone｜跟着某人复述
tip: repeat已含“再次”之意，通常不必再加again。

senses.en: to greet someone warmly or accept something with pleasure
wanted, appreciated, or gladly accepted
the way someone is greeted when they arrive

ex.en: Our neighbours came outside to welcome us home.
ex.zh: 邻居们走到外面，欢迎我们回家。

ex.en: Many communities welcome new cultural festivals because they encourage social interaction and support local businesses.
ex.zh: 许多社区欢迎新的文化节庆活动，因为这些活动能促进社交互动并支持当地商家。

col: a welcome change｜令人欣喜的变化
tip: be welcome to do表示可随意做；You're welcome用于回应感谢。

senses.en: a soft red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface

ex.en: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
ex.zh: 我摘了一颗熟透的草莓，放进篮子里。

ex.en: Growing strawberries locally can reduce transport distances, although heated greenhouses may increase overall energy consumption.
ex.zh: 在本地种植草莓可以缩短运输距离，但加温温室可能增加总体能源消耗。

tip: 可数名词，复数为strawberries。

senses.en: a period of seven days
the days or hours normally spent working each week

ex.en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
ex.zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。

ex.en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
ex.zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。

tip: last/next/this week前不加介词。

senses.en: a large reptile with tough skin, long jaws and tail

ex.en: We watched a crocodile slide into the river.
ex.zh: 我们看着一条鳄鱼滑入河中。

ex.en: Wetland conservation protects crocodile habitats while also supporting the fish and birds that depend on these ecosystems.
ex.zh: 湿地保护既能保护鳄鱼的栖息地，也有利于依赖这些生态系统的鱼类和鸟类。

col: crocodile tears｜假慈悲；虚假的眼泪
tip: alligator指短吻鳄，与crocodile并非同一种动物。

senses.en: the day after Tuesday and before Thursday

ex.en: We meet for lunch every Wednesday near the library.
ex.zh: 我们每周三在图书馆附近一起吃午饭。

ex.en: The community centre offers free language classes every Wednesday to help newcomers participate in local life.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周三提供免费语言课程，帮助新来者融入当地生活。

tip: 首字母大写；on Wednesday，但every Wednesday前不加on。

senses.en: Having little colour, or less colour than usual.
Giving only a weak light.
To lose colour or seem less impressive in comparison.

ex.en: You look pale; sit down and have some water.
ex.zh: 你脸色苍白，坐下来喝点水吧。

ex.en: The financial benefits of tourism may pale in comparison with its long-term environmental costs.
ex.zh: 与旅游业带来的长期环境代价相比，其经济收益可能显得微不足道。

col: pale in comparison｜相比之下相形见绌
tip: pale可指脸色苍白或颜色浅，不等于白色。

senses.en: Twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.

ex.en: Let's meet outside the library at noon tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们明天中午在图书馆外见吧。

ex.en: Outdoor workers should avoid intense physical activity around noon, when temperatures and sunlight can be particularly strong.
ex.zh: 户外工作者应避免在正午前后进行高强度体力活动，此时气温可能很高，阳光也可能特别强烈。

tip: 说at noon，不说in noon；正午是12 p.m.。

senses.en: in the morning, before midday

ex.en: The shop opens at nine a.m.
ex.zh: 商店上午九点开门。

ex.en: She gets up at six a.m. every day.
ex.zh: 她每天早上六点起床。

tip: a.m. 表示上午（午夜后至正午前）；p.m. 表示下午。
scene: A wall clock showing nine in the morning with a shop opening.

senses.en: an informal greeting

ex.en: Hi, how are you today?
ex.zh: 嗨，你今天好吗？

ex.en: She said hi to everyone in the class.
ex.zh: 她向班里的每个人打招呼。

tip: hi 比 hello 更随意，朋友间常用。
scene: A girl waving and saying hi to friends at a school gate.

senses.en: the thing or person here or now

ex.en: This is my favourite book.
ex.zh: 这是我最喜欢的书。

ex.en: This cake tastes wonderful.
ex.zh: 这个蛋糕尝起来很美味。

tip: this 指近处/当前的事物；that 指远处。复数 these。
scene: A hand holding up a colourful book, saying this is my favourite.

senses.en: to move to a sitting position

ex.en: Please sit down and open your books.
ex.zh: 请坐下，打开课本。

ex.en: He sat down next to his friend on the bench.
ex.zh: 他坐在长椅上朋友旁边。

tip: sit down 是“坐下”的动作；反义 stand up（起立）。
scene: Students sitting down at their desks in a classroom.

senses.en: an official document allowing someone to do something
freedom to depart from usual rules or factual accuracy

ex.en: I keep my driving licence in my wallet.
ex.zh: 我把驾驶执照放在钱包里。

ex.en: Requiring a licence to operate tourist boats can help authorities maintain safety standards on busy waterways.
ex.zh: 要求旅游船持证运营，可以帮助主管部门维持繁忙水道的安全标准。

col: apply for a licence｜申请许可证
tip: 英式名词用licence，动词用license；美式都用license。

senses.en: A large hunting bird with powerful claws and sharp eyesight

ex.en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
ex.zh: 一只鹰在岩石遍布的山谷上方缓缓盘旋。

ex.en: Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.
ex.zh: 保护山地森林有助于保全鹰的猎食区和筑巢地。

tip: eagle通常指大型猛禽；eagle-eyed形容眼力敏锐。

senses.en: Recently made, discovered, introduced, or begun.
Recently obtained or experienced by someone, though possibly already existing.
Not yet familiar with a place, activity, or situation.

ex.en: Our new neighbours brought us a basket of apples.
ex.zh: 我们的新邻居送来了一篮苹果。

ex.en: New technologies can make healthcare more accessible, but their benefits must be shared across different income groups.
ex.zh: 新技术能让医疗服务更易获得，但不同收入群体都应能享受到这些益处。

col: new to the job｜刚接触这份工作
tip: be new to表示初次接触、不熟悉，to是介词。

senses.en: an official document showing successful completion of a course

ex.en: She proudly showed her diploma to her grandparents.
ex.zh: 她自豪地向祖父母展示了自己的毕业文凭。

ex.en: A vocational diploma can provide practical skills that help graduates find employment in specialised industries.
ex.zh: 职业教育文凭课程可以提供实用技能，帮助毕业生在专业行业中找到工作。

col: diploma in nursing｜护理专业文凭
tip: diploma多指毕业或课程文凭，不等同于degree学位。

senses.en: The activity of preparing food by heating it.
Intended for use in preparing food.

ex.en: My brother does the cooking while I wash dishes.
ex.zh: 我哥哥做饭，我洗碗。

ex.en: Teaching basic cooking skills at school can help young people develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 在学校教授基本烹饪技能，有助于年轻人养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: cooking指烹饪活动；cook可指厨师，cooker指炊具。

senses.en: the red liquid that carries oxygen around your body
family relationships or origins

ex.en: The nurse took some blood from my arm.
ex.zh: 护士从我的手臂抽了一些血。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can lower blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart disease.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育活动可以降低血压，并减少患心脏病的风险。

tip: blood通常不可数；一次验血用a blood test。

senses.en: A small folding case for carrying money and cards.

ex.en: I left my wallet beside the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 我把钱包落在厨房水槽旁了。

ex.en: As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.
ex.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，需要在钱包里携带现金的消费者越来越少。

tip: wallet通常指放纸币和卡片的折叠式钱包。

senses.en: a small hotel or house where people pay to stay

ex.en: We stayed at a lovely guest-house by the beach.
ex.zh: 我们住在海边一家可爱的家庭旅馆。

ex.en: The guest-house serves breakfast every morning.
ex.zh: 这家家庭旅馆每天早上提供早餐。

tip: guest-house 是小型旅馆，通常比酒店便宜、更温馨。
scene: A cosy small guest-house with flowers by the door near a beach.

senses.en: a group of people related to one another
a group of related animals, plants, languages, or other things

ex.en: My family gathers around the kitchen table every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我的家人每周日都会围坐在厨房的餐桌旁。

ex.en: Flexible working hours can help parents balance family responsibilities with the demands of paid employment.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助父母平衡家庭责任与有偿工作的要求。

tip: family作整体用单数；英式英语强调成员时可用复数。

senses.en: Something specific that shows what a general idea means
A person or action that others can learn from or copy

ex.en: Could you give me an example of a healthy breakfast?
ex.zh: 你能给我举一个健康早餐的例子吗？

ex.en: Public buildings can set an example by using renewable energy and reducing unnecessary water consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑可以通过使用可再生能源和减少不必要的用水来树立榜样。

tip: for example用于举例；set an example意为树立榜样。

senses.en: the final month of the year, following November

ex.en: My cousin is coming to stay with us in December.
ex.zh: 我表亲十二月要来我们家住。

ex.en: In many northern countries, energy demand increases in December as households need more heating during colder weather.
ex.zh: 在许多北方国家，十二月天气更冷，家庭需要更多供暖，因此能源需求增加。

tip: 月份首字母大写；在十二月用in December。

senses.en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The bakery delivers warm bread to our door every morning.
ex.zh: 面包店每天早上把热乎乎的面包送到我们家门口。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: To dislike someone or something very strongly.
A very strong feeling of dislike towards someone or something.

ex.en: I hate finding wet socks on the bathroom floor.
ex.zh: 我特别讨厌在浴室地板上发现湿袜子。

ex.en: Although many commuters hate crowded trains, affordable public transport remains essential for reducing urban traffic.
ex.zh: 虽然许多通勤者讨厌拥挤的列车，但价格实惠的公共交通对于缓解城市交通拥堵仍然至关重要。

tip: hate后可接动名词或不定式，语气比dislike强。

senses.en: A large group of people gathered in one place.
To gather closely together or fill a place with people.

ex.en: A crowd gathered around the musicians in the square.
ex.zh: 一群人聚在广场上的乐手周围。

ex.en: Large crowds at popular attractions can damage historic sites unless visitor numbers are carefully managed.
ex.zh: 热门景点的大量游客可能破坏历史遗址，除非游客数量得到妥善管理。

tip: a crowd of后接复数名词；crowded表示拥挤的。

senses.en: to rest with eyes closed and awareness reduced
the natural resting state in which awareness is reduced

ex.en: Our cat likes to sleep beside the warm radiator.
ex.zh: 我们的猫喜欢睡在温暖的暖气片旁边。

ex.en: Regular sleep supports memory and concentration, making it particularly important for students preparing for examinations.
ex.zh: 规律的睡眠有助于记忆和注意力，因此对备考学生尤其重要。

col: get enough sleep｜获得充足睡眠
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为slept；入睡用fall asleep。

senses.en: A small brush used for cleaning your teeth.

ex.en: I packed my toothbrush in the side pocket.
ex.zh: 我把牙刷装进了侧面的口袋。

ex.en: Replacing a worn toothbrush regularly helps maintain oral hygiene by ensuring that teeth are cleaned effectively.
ex.zh: 定期更换磨损的牙刷有助于确保牙齿得到有效清洁，从而保持口腔卫生。

tip: 复数是toothbrushes，不是teethbrushes。

senses.en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
information arranged in rows and columns

ex.en: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们围坐在桌边，一起吃新鲜面包。

ex.en: The table compares average household spending on transport in three cities over a ten-year period.
ex.zh: 该表比较了三个城市十年间的家庭平均交通支出。

tip: set the table指摆餐具，不是摆放桌子。

senses.zh: 名；名字（名字中的第一个词）
senses.en: your personal name, not your family name

ex.en: My first name is Anna and my surname is Green.
ex.zh: 我的名字叫安娜，姓格林。

ex.en: Please write your first name in the box.
ex.zh: 请在方框里写下你的名字。

tip: first name 是“名”，surname/family name 是“姓”。
scene: A form with first name and surname boxes being filled in.

senses.en: to tell someone you are grateful

ex.en: I want to thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 我想感谢你的帮助。

ex.en: She thanked the teacher for the present.
ex.zh: 她感谢老师送的礼物。

tip: thank sb for sth 是“为某事感谢某人”；thank you 是谢谢。
scene: A student thanking a teacher and receiving a wrapped gift.

senses.en: To become a member or take part with others.
To connect things or become connected.
To go where someone is and spend time with them.

ex.en: Would you like to join us for lunch today?
ex.zh: 你今天愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？

ex.en: Students who join local volunteer groups can develop practical skills while contributing to their communities.
ex.zh: 加入当地志愿者团体的学生可以在服务社区的同时培养实用技能。

tip: join a club指加入组织；join in指参与活动。

senses.en: the sport of moving on skates

ex.en: Skating on the frozen lake is great fun.
ex.zh: 在结冰的湖面上滑冰很好玩。

ex.en: She learned skating when she was six.
ex.zh: 她六岁就学会了滑冰。

tip: skating 指溜冰运动；ice skating 特指滑冰。
scene: A girl skating gracefully on an outdoor ice rink.

senses.en: a reduction in the usual price
to sell something at a reduced price
to consider something unlikely or less important

ex.en: The shop offers a discount on winter coats.
ex.zh: 这家店的冬季外套有折扣。

ex.en: Public transport discounts can encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 公共交通票价优惠能鼓励更多通勤者不开车出门。

col: discount the possibility｜不考虑这种可能性
tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词通常读/dɪsˈkaʊnt/。

senses.en: Helping you do something or achieve a purpose

ex.en: This little torch is useful when the power fails.
ex.zh: 停电时，这个小手电筒很有用。

ex.en: Reliable online resources can be useful for learners who lack access to well-equipped libraries.
ex.zh: 对于无法使用设备完善的图书馆的学习者来说，可靠的网络资源可能很有帮助。

tip: 首音是辅音/j/，所以说a useful tool，不用an。

senses.en: to enjoy something or feel positively about someone
similar to someone or something
used to introduce an example

ex.en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
ex.zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。

ex.en: Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.
ex.zh: 许多居民喜欢附近有绿地，因为绿地提供了锻炼和放松的机会。

col: feel like doing something｜想做某事
tip: would like to do 比 want to do 更礼貌。

senses.en: A short written message or record of useful information.
To notice something or record it in writing.
A single musical sound or a symbol representing it.

ex.en: I left a note beside your breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 我在你的早餐碗旁留了一张便条。

ex.en: Students who take notes in their own words may develop a deeper understanding of complex material.
ex.zh: 用自己的话记笔记的学生可能会对复杂的学习材料形成更深入的理解。

tip: 记笔记用take notes；note that后接完整句子。

senses.en: To move downward, lose balance, or decrease.
An act of falling or a decrease in amount.
The season between summer and winter, especially in American English.

ex.en: Golden leaves fall onto the path outside our house.
ex.zh: 金黄的叶子落在我们屋外的小路上。

ex.en: Energy consumption may fall if governments encourage households to install better insulation and efficient heating systems.
ex.zh: 如果政府鼓励家庭改善隔热条件并安装高效供暖系统，能源消耗可能会下降。

tip: 过去式fell，过去分词fallen；秋天英式常用autumn。

senses.en: an enclosed appliance used to bake or roast food

ex.en: The bread is still warm from the oven.
ex.zh: 面包刚出烤箱，还热乎着。

ex.en: Using an energy-efficient oven can reduce household electricity consumption without changing cooking habits significantly.
ex.zh: 使用节能烤箱可以减少家庭用电量，而不必大幅改变烹饪习惯。

col: bake in the oven｜放入烤箱烘烤
tip: oven指封闭烤箱；炉顶灶具通常叫hob或stove。

senses.en: a long board used for surfing on waves

ex.en: He carried his surfboard to the beach.
ex.zh: 他把冲浪板带到海滩。

ex.en: The surfboard floats on the water easily.
ex.zh: 冲浪板很容易浮在水上。

tip: surfboard 是冲浪板；surfing 是冲浪运动。
scene: A colourful surfboard standing in the sand at a sunny beach.

senses.en: Worse than all others in quality, condition, or effect.
More badly or severely than anyone or anything else.

senses.zh: 最坏的情况；最糟的部分
senses.en: The most unpleasant situation, outcome, or part.

ex.en: That was the worst meal I have ever cooked.
ex.zh: 那是我做过的最糟糕的一顿饭。

ex.en: The worst effects of air pollution are often experienced by children and older people in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的城市，儿童和老年人往往受到空气污染最严重的影响。

col: the worst possible outcome｜最坏的可能结果
prepare for the worst｜做最坏的打算
tip: worst是bad和badly的最高级；比较级是worse。

senses.en: Better than all others in quality or suitability.
In the most successful way or to the greatest degree.
The finest performance, effort, or thing available.

ex.en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店做的面包是我们街区最好的。

ex.en: Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.
ex.zh: 投资早期教育可能是逐步减少不平等的最佳方式。

col: at its best｜处于最佳状态
tip: best是good和well的最高级；形容词前通常加the。

senses.en: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction.
Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things.
At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.

ex.en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
ex.zh: 这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all children can attend school without facing any financial barriers.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能上学，不受任何经济障碍的阻碍。

col: any of these｜这些中的任何一个
tip: 疑问、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。

senses.en: An electronic machine that stores and processes information using programs.

ex.en: My computer froze while I was editing holiday photos.
ex.zh: 我编辑度假照片时，电脑卡住了。

ex.en: Access to a computer at home can help students complete assignments and develop essential digital skills.
ex.zh: 在家能使用电脑可以帮助学生完成作业，并培养必要的数字技能。

tip: 在电脑上工作用work on a computer。

senses.en: someone who trains people to improve their sporting skills
a comfortable bus used for longer journeys
to train or teach someone to improve particular skills

ex.en: Our coach showed us how to hold the racket.
ex.zh: 我们的教练示范了如何握球拍。

ex.en: A skilled coach can help young athletes build confidence while developing healthy attitudes towards competition.
ex.zh: 优秀的教练能帮助年轻运动员建立信心，同时培养他们对竞争的健康态度。

col: travel by coach｜乘长途客车出行
coach a team｜训练一支队伍
coach someone for an exam｜辅导某人备考
tip: 英式英语中coach也指长途客车，bus多指公交车。

senses.en: a machine that produces power to make something move
something that strongly drives growth or change
software that performs a particular core task within a system

ex.en: The engine stopped just as we reached the driveway.
ex.zh: 我们刚到车道入口，发动机就熄火了。

ex.en: Cleaner engine technology can reduce air pollution, although expanding public transport remains essential for sustainable urban travel.
ex.zh: 更清洁的发动机技术可以减少空气污染，但扩大公共交通仍是实现城市可持续出行的关键。

col: an engine of growth｜增长的推动力
tip: engine多指燃料发动机；电动机通常用motor。

senses.en: The activity of looking for and buying things.
The things you have bought during a shopping trip.

ex.en: We usually do our shopping early on Saturday mornings.
ex.zh: 我们通常在星期六一早去购物。

ex.en: The growth of online shopping has changed consumer habits and increased demand for home delivery services.
ex.zh: 网上购物的发展改变了消费者习惯，也增加了对送货上门服务的需求。

tip: shopping作名词不可数；“去购物”用go shopping。

senses.en: Details identifying where someone lives or something can be found.
To give attention to a problem and try to solve it.
To speak directly to a person or group.

ex.en: Please send me your address before I post the parcel.
ex.zh: 请在我寄包裹之前把你的地址发给我。

ex.en: Governments need to address housing shortages by supporting affordable construction and improving public transport links.
ex.zh: 政府需要通过支持可负担住房建设和改善公共交通连接来应对住房短缺。

tip: 美音动词读/əˈdres/；address问题不等于已解决。

senses.en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services
a proposed law being considered by a lawmaking body
a piece of paper money, especially in American English

ex.en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
ex.zh: 吃完午饭后，我们请服务员拿来账单。

ex.en: The proposed bill would require companies to disclose more information about their impact on the environment.
ex.zh: 这项拟议法案将要求企业披露更多有关其环境影响的信息。

col: a dollar bill｜一张美元钞票
tip: bill是待审议的法案；通过并生效后才成为法律。

senses.en: used to give advice or say what is right
used to say something is expected or likely
used with have to describe an unfulfilled duty or expectation

ex.en: You should take an umbrella because it looks cloudy.
ex.zh: 你应该带把伞，因为天看起来阴沉沉的。

ex.en: Governments should invest in affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应该投资于价格实惠的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

col: should be able to｜应该能够
tip: 情态动词，后接动词原形；should have done常指本该做却未做。

senses.en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things.
The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.

ex.en: We cycle to school to help protect the environment.
ex.zh: 我们骑车上学，为保护环境出一份力。

ex.en: A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.
ex.zh: 支持性的学习环境能够增强学生的信心，鼓励他们更加积极地参与。

tip: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

senses.en: sent through the mail

ex.en: I sent the birthday card by post.
ex.zh: 我把生日贺卡寄出去了。

ex.en: You can pay by post or online.
ex.zh: 你可以邮寄付款或在线付款。

tip: by post 是英式说法，美式常说 by mail。
scene: A red postbox with letters and a birthday card being posted.

senses.en: without faults, or exactly right for a particular purpose
to improve something until it is as good as possible
describing verb forms using have with a past participle

ex.en: This quiet corner is perfect for reading after lunch.
ex.zh: 这个安静的角落特别适合午饭后看书。

ex.en: Although no transport system is perfect, reliable public services can significantly reduce a city's dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 尽管没有完美的交通系统，可靠的公共交通服务仍能显著减少城市对汽车的依赖。

col: perfect a technique｜完善一项技术
tip: 形容词重音在前；动词读/pəˈfekt/（英）。

senses.en: To succeed in a competition or receive a prize.
To gain something through effort or personal qualities.
A successful result in a competition or contest.

ex.en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们队还是赢得了比赛。

ex.en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。

col: win someone's trust｜赢得某人的信任
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为won；赢比赛用win，击败人用beat。

senses.en: To become bigger or develop over time.
To raise plants for food or other purposes.
To gradually become different in condition or feeling.

ex.en: We grow fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房窗边的花盆里种新鲜香草。

ex.en: As cities grow, local authorities must invest in transport systems that serve expanding populations.
ex.zh: 随着城市发展，地方政府必须投资建设满足不断增长的人口需求的交通系统。

col: grow increasingly concerned｜变得越来越担忧
tip: 过去式grew，过去分词grown；表变得后接形容词。

senses.en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid
to put something into a box
to compete in a sport using punches and protective gloves

ex.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
ex.zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
ex.zh: 零售商可以选择与每件商品大小相近的箱子，以减少包装浪费。

col: a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力
tip: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

senses.en: Happening once a week or relating to one week
Once every week
A newspaper or magazine published once a week

ex.en: Our weekly shopping trip usually ends at the bakery.
ex.zh: 我们每周的购物之行通常以去面包店收尾。

ex.en: Weekly exercise classes at community centres can help older residents stay active and build social connections.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周开设的健身课可以帮助老年居民保持活力并建立社交联系。

tip: 既可作形容词也可作副词：a weekly meeting；meet weekly。

senses.en: hanging fabric used to cover a window or divide space
a large hanging cloth that hides or reveals a stage

ex.en: She pulled the curtain aside to watch the rain.
ex.zh: 她把窗帘拉到一边，看着外面的雨。

ex.en: Installing a thick curtain over each window can reduce heat loss and improve comfort in older homes.
ex.zh: 在每扇窗户上安装厚窗帘，可以减少热量流失，提升老房屋的居住舒适度。

col: draw the curtains｜拉上或拉开窗帘
tip: draw the curtains可指拉开或拉上，需看语境。

senses.en: a short announcement or film that tells people about a product

ex.en: I saw an advert for the new phone on TV.
ex.zh: 我在电视上看到新手机的广告。

ex.en: The shop put an advert in the local newspaper.
ex.zh: 这家商店在本地报纸上登了广告。

tip: advert 是英式口语说法，等于 advertisement。
scene: A bright TV screen showing a colourful soft drink advert in a living room.

senses.en: Enjoyment or pleasure from an activity or experience.
Enjoyable and entertaining.

ex.en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们一起堆沙堡，玩得特别开心。

ex.en: Making physical activity fun can encourage children to exercise regularly and develop healthier habits throughout their lives.
ex.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童经常锻炼，并养成终身受益的健康习惯。

tip: fun作名词不可数；funny多指好笑的或奇怪的。

senses.en: to move something towards you or along by holding it
an act of pulling or a force drawing something closer
to injure a muscle by stretching it too much

ex.en: Please pull the door gently instead of pushing it.
ex.zh: 请轻轻拉门，不要推。

ex.en: Horses once pulled heavy loads through cities, but motor vehicles eventually replaced them in most transport roles.
ex.zh: 马匹曾在城市中拉运重物，但机动车最终取代了它们的大部分运输职能。

col: pull a door open｜把门拉开
tip: pull是朝自己方向拉；push是向外推。

senses.en: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area
The amount of data or messages passing through a system

ex.en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。

senses.en: Hair growing on a person's chin and cheeks.

ex.en: He trimmed his beard before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 他上班出门前修剪了胡须。

ex.en: In some workplaces, employees with beards must use special coverings to maintain food hygiene standards.
ex.zh: 在一些工作场所，蓄胡须的员工必须佩戴专用罩具，以符合食品卫生标准。

tip: beard指下巴及两颊胡须；moustache指上唇胡须。
